welcome.intro: {{brand}} is a learning app for kids from kindergarten to the end of 2nd grade. Practice math, reading and writing step by step along a mountain trail, aligned with the Swiss Lehrplan 21.

parentGate.title: Parent area
parentGate.intro: Grown-ups only: please enter your password.

altcha.enterCodeAria: Enter the code you hear. Press Space to play the audio.
altcha.label: I’m human
altcha.verificationRequired: Please confirm that you are human.

login.title: Sign in
login.totpIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the current code.
login.recoveryIntro: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
login.useCode: Use a code from the app

register.title: Create account
register.intro: One parent account for the whole family. Afterwards you add a profile for each kid.
register.closed: New accounts are invitation-only right now. Please ask the person who runs this site.
register.done: Almost done! We sent an email to {{email}}. Click the link in it to confirm your account.
register.acceptAfter: and agree as a parent or legal guardian.
register.termsRequired: Please accept the privacy policy and the terms of use.
register.altchaRequired: Please confirm first that you are human.

setup.title: Welcome to {{brand}}!
setup.intro: Create the first account. It becomes the administrator of this installation.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.registrationDone: Thank you! Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verifyEmail.emailChangeDone: Your new email address is confirmed.
verifyEmail.resent: If an unconfirmed account belongs to this address, we sent a new email.
verifyEmail.resendIntro: Didn’t get an email? We can send you a new one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address. We will send you a link to reset it.
forgotPassword.done: If an account belongs to this address, an email is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.done: Your password is changed. For your security, all devices were signed out.

invite.title: You’re invited!
invite.intro: Choose a password for {{email}} and you’re ready to go.

pin.title: Hi {{name}}! Tap your 4 pictures.
pin.keyboardHint: Use the keys 1 to 9 to choose a picture and Backspace to remove the last one.

pinSetup.first: Pick 4 pictures in an order your kid can remember.
pinSetup.mismatch: The pictures did not match. Please start again.

learn.soon: Coming soon! The mountain trail is being built.

kidForm.nicknameHint: No real name needed. At most 20 characters.
kidForm.pinIntro: A picture PIN keeps siblings from opening the wrong profile by accident. It does not protect against adults.
kidForm.pinMissing: Please set the picture PIN or choose “No PIN”.

parent.deleteKidMessage: The profile and all learning progress of {{name}} will be deleted for good.

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: Your password is changed. Other devices were signed out.
account.emailSent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. The change applies once you click it.
account.exportIntro: Download all data of your account and kid profiles as a JSON file.
account.deleteIntro: Deletes your account, all kid profiles and all learning progress for good. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirmMessage: All data is deleted immediately and for good.

totp.requiredNotice: Two-factor sign-in is required for the admin area. Set it up here to continue.

users.deleteMessage: The account, all kid profiles and all progress will be deleted for good.

invites.email_disabled: Email is not set up. Please share this link with {{email}} yourself:

settings.title: Settings
settings.registrationEnabledHint: When off, new families can only join by invitation.
settings.requireAdminTotpHint: Admins without two-factor sign-in can then only set it up.
settings.emailOff: Email sending is not set up. You need to share invitations by hand.

legal.draft: Draft: this text will be completed and reviewed by experts before launch.

stored.title: What we store
stored.text: For the parent account: email address, a hashed password, language and theme. To keep you signed in we only set strictly necessary cookies.

kids.title: Kids’ data
kids.text: A kid profile only holds a nickname, a drawn avatar, the starting level or birth year, settings and learning progress. Real names are not needed.

noPhotos.title: No photos, no recordings
noPhotos.text: {{brand}} never asks for photos, the camera or the microphone.

noTrackers.title: No trackers
noTrackers.text: No ads, no analytics, no fonts or scripts from other servers. Everything runs on this server.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We only use session cookies for signing in, the parent area and the active kid profile. That is why there is no cookie banner.

rights.title: Download and delete
rights.text: In the parent area you can download all data at any time or delete your account with all kid profiles for good (nFADP, GDPR).

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: The person or organization running this installation is responsible. Contact details will follow.

purpose.title: What {{brand}} is for
purpose.text: {{brand}} is a learning app for kids from kindergarten to the end of 2nd grade, aligned with Lehrplan 21.

accounts.title: Parent account
accounts.text: An adult parent or legal guardian opens the account and is responsible for the kid profiles.

kids.title: Kids
kids.text: Kids only use {{brand}} through a profile in the parent account. They do not need their own email address.

content.title: Content
content.text: The exercises may be used for your own learning. Redistribution or resale is not allowed.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: We do our best to make everything correct and working, but cannot guarantee it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If these terms change, we will let you know by email.
